prompt:
Create ONE two-view environment target board based on the ACTUAL GAME SCREENSHOTS. This corrects the previous proposal: BOTH old-city and NEW-CITY mountains/vegetation must be redesigned, and CLOUDS MUST WRAP AROUND THE MOUNTAINS, like reference4, not merely sit high in the sky.
REFERENCES:
Image1 = authoritative current overall camera and buildings, use as TOP panel.
Image2 = authoritative current new-city reverse/side camera showing mountain under and beside domed citadel, use as BOTTOM panel.
Image3 = previous environment target, reference only for muted limestone/sage palette; DO NOT copy its high sky-cloud arrangement.
Image4 = Oskar's fluffy cloud experiment: reference for low clustered clouds interacting with landforms, partial occlusion and layered volume.
BOARD: two very wide landscape views stacked vertically, same width, a thin unobtrusive gap. Approximately square overall canvas. Top is overall scene, bottom is new-city side. Each view keeps its own original camera, crop, planet curvature, positions and proportions. Small panel labels “全景 · 新旧城山体与绕山云” and “新城侧面 · 山坡与植被”. Small bottom caption “环境目标图 · 建筑保留现状 · 非实机”. No other panels, no arrows, no invented maps.
ABSOLUTE ARCHITECTURE LOCK in BOTH panels: reproduce existing buildings, their muted colors, size, silhouette and approximate detail from the ACTUAL screenshots. Exact old town dense clustered dark houses/tall thin tower, right blocky stepped citadel with existing teal dome and small red domes, existing angular bridges, stairs, circular plaza, railway alignments and embankments. No redesign, no new architecture, no beautification of castle, no enlarged domes or richer ornaments. Keep platforms/plaza/pier/path surfaces clear. The later project will redesign buildings separately.
ENVIRONMENT IMPROVEMENT, BOTH SIDES: preserve existing overall peak heights and rock footprint, add visibly coherent rock shoulders and small soil-bearing ledges within natural terrain, eliminate paper-thin spike impressions with weighted faceted rock transitions. Warm pale limestone lit planes, muted slate/bluegrey shade. Quiet stylized Oskar-inspired broad forms and coherent soft directional illumination, not photoreal or ornate.
NEW CITY IS ESSENTIAL: in bottom panel, make the currently bare lower front mountain and narrow side/back ridges UNDER THE NEW CITY into a legible combination of exposed steep grey rock walls, gently sloped sage-green shelves and several overlapping rounded grey-green broadleaf canopy clusters. Include plants at natural castle-wall/rock feet but never cover walls/plaza/rail. Soften the huge barren mountain's upper grass boundary with low shrubs, stones and small bare gaps; not triangular green decals. The new city remains firmly supported by original rock foundation, no floating city and no planting on vertical cliffs. In top panel make corresponding terrain to left/below/right of large dome visibly improved too, so it does not remain the unedited side.
Trees: coherent irregular groves with joined canopy silhouettes, sparse small cypress accents, broad grass clearings, fine uneven grass-to-soil-to-bare-rock transitions. Retain real bare cliffs and narrow ravines. Green trees have foliage material, never brick texture.
THE CLOUD CORRECTION MUST BE OBVIOUS: reduce high-sky clouds to nearly none. Instead place 3–4 interrupted low fluffy CLOUD RIBBONS at MOUNTAIN SHOULDER/MID-SLOPE HEIGHT. Each has lobed white bodies, gently blue-grey shaded lower sides and tapered wispy ends. A band wraps behind the left rear peak and reappears along its side; another bends through the middle saddle while leaving its ground path clear; most importantly a low bank curls around the OUTER NEW-CITY MOUNTAIN SIDE beneath and behind the domed city. In side view this low cloud is clearly seen wrapping around the curved natural ridge, partially occluded by rock, with some lobes in front of a bare flank and others behind, expressing real depth. Bands follow the mountain landform as broken arcs, not perfect torus rings, not halos, not sky wallpaper and not one horizontal fog layer. Keep all castle/dome/tower silhouette and railway route legible and cloud-free. Cloud cover restricted to perhaps 10–15% of natural rock, never hiding terrain quality. Clouds do NOT intersect walls. Their bottoms hover beside rock shelves, not plastered onto slopes. This is a static concept of cloud placement, no claim of animation.
Preserve dark teal water from source screenshots. Keep current engine-like appearance for built structures; natural environment should be a achievable game-art upgrade. No debug lines or yellow editor outlines. Both panels should read as faithful paintovers of current screenshots with the corrected natural environment, not a new fantasy city.
scope: Environment concept includes both old and new city terrain/vegetation and low mountain-wrapping clouds. Architecture remains deferred. Runtime optimisation still paused.
review: Two actual camera references preserve recognizable architecture/plaza/rail. Low cloud banks have foreground/background mountain occlusion. Generated outer new-city ridges and background sea are proposals, not verified current geometry; implementation must preserve protected footprint and transport clearance. Static target cannot demonstrate cloud animation.
